caption_style.observed_unit: predominantly one spoken word at a time

visual_editing.transition_character: mostly direct cuts; minimal decorative transition
visual_editing.story_visual_relationship: visual changes track the currently narrated event, object, character, or location

audio.pause_pattern: mostly micro-pauses under 0.4 seconds with occasional longer beat pause
audio.reference_loudness_note: reference is unusually hot; production should normalize more safely

production_adaptation.caption_timing_source: word-boundary timestamps emitted by the generated narration audio

production_adaptation.baseline_mode: return to stable branded storytelling stage when no supporting visual is justified
forbidden: image changes solely to create motion
caption blocks containing large script paragraphs
